scenario: Errors-as-values runtime per LERR.1.2 — the integrator asserts a CallError fact (via ds_engine_assert after a failed call); a sibling rule pattern-matches the code and fires. Simulates the integrator's response role: harness directly asserts CallError, verifies handle_error fires.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule handle_error:
    CallError e where e.code == "timeout"
->
    log critical "timeout"
